en-US.title: IgniteKit - Portfolio
en-US.subtitle: Developer Portfolio by Shiv Shankar Tiwari
en-US.description:
IgniteKit is an open-source React Native portfolio app showcasing modern mobile development practices.

This app demonstrates:

• Professional React Native development with TypeScript
• Beautiful, responsive UI with light/dark mode support
• Automated CI/CD deployment to both app stores
• Clean architecture and best practices

Built by Shiv Shankar Tiwari, a mobile engineer and founder passionate about creating polished apps and the DevOps pipelines that ship them.

The entire source code is open source on GitHub, serving as a reference implementation for developers looking to build and deploy their own React Native apps with automated pipelines.

Features:
• Portfolio showcase with projects and skills
• Professional experience timeline
• Social links and contact options
• Fully automated App Store delivery via EAS + GitHub Actions
